name: Platform case study filter grid
purpose: Lets a visitor narrow the platform case studies by industry, use case and company size and pick a story from the matching cards.
description: Dark-theme block: left-aligned H2, then a filter bar ("All" reset + three click-open checkbox dropdowns with two-column option lists; OR within a dropdown, AND across them; the button shows the ticked values) above a 3-column grid (2 at 991 and below, 1 at 767 and below) of rounded case-study cards with a customer logo and a two-line headline. Shows an empty-state line when no card matches. On /case-studies/lms the bar stays in flow (stickyBar false).

evidenceNotes: The "All" reset label is hardcoded (not modelled). The page passes only heading, stickyBar and allClassName; filters and the 49 cards are the component defaults (item `useCase` prop renamed `useCases` here; the code field key is `useCase`, an array).
Sample truncates each filter to 3 options and the grid to 3 cards (real: 17 / 24 / 7 options, 49 cards).
pages-manifest.json lists the following "results" section on /case-studies/lms as reusing the shared Results component; the page actually renders a page-local CaseStudyResults block.
